mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital and increases equity valuation multiples, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active and the direction is determined by the current level of FEDFUNDS (lower levels predict positive returns).
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return correlation with FEDFUNDS level is less than 0.05 in absolute value over any 3-year rolling window, or the average positive return in the bottom 25% of FEDFUNDS levels is not significantly higher than the average return in the top 25% (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 9.5% signals a weak labor market and economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal activates when UNRATE crosses above 9.5%.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods when UNRATE > 9.5% are not significantly negative (average return > -0.5% or t-test p>0.05) or the condition is met less than 10% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the annualized inflation rate (computed from CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.0% and the federal funds rate is below 0.5%, the real interest rate is high, which compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods meeting the trigger condition (CPIAUCSL growth rate > 2.0% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) are not significantly negative (average return > -0.5% or t-test p>0.05) or the condition is met less than 10% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: In a demand-driven expansion regime (defined by housing starts (HOUST) above 600 thousand units and residential sales (RSAFS) above 370,000 million dollars), consumer and business confidence is high, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods meeting the regime condition (HOUST>600 and RSAFS>370000) are not significantly positive (average return < 0.5% or t-test p>0.05) or the condition is met less than 10% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90 (2017=100) signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods when INDPRO < 90 are not significantly negative (average return > -0.5% or t-test p>0.05) or the condition is met less than 10% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A high annualized inflation rate (computed from CPIAUCSL) leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. The signal is always active and the direction is determined by the current inflation rate (higher rates predict negative returns).
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return correlation with CPIAUCSL growth rate is less than 0.05 in absolute value over any 3-year rolling window, or the average negative return in the top 25% of inflation rates is not significantly lower than the average return in the bottom 25% (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates a robust economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. The signal is always active and the direction is determined by the current GDP growth rate (higher growth predicts positive returns).
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return correlation with GDPC1 growth rate is less than 0.05 in absolute value over any 3-year rolling window, or the average positive return in the top 25% of GDP growth rates is not significantly higher than the average return in the bottom 25% (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST) above 620 thousand units signal strong consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods when HOUST > 620 are not significantly positive (average return < 0.5% or t-test p>0.05) or the condition is met less than 10% of the time.
